result.legend: Valid Scala: each note is a trailing `// ⟹` comment, no line-number gutter. Notes show compiler insertions invisible in the source: `(using …)` implicit args, `name(…)` implicit conversion, `[…]` inferred type args, `: T` inferred type. symbols=on adds a type→package legend. sentinel=on: each note is appended as a `/*SEM:...:SEM*/` block comment instead of a `⟹` note — strippable via `SourceSentinel.strip` (analysis module), which removes exactly that block and leaves everything else on the line untouched.
